instruction: Find the Help Center page with frequently asked questions.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Help/FAQ page. Similar pattern to original task. Evaluator checks URL contains both 'help' and 'faq' patterns using existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses a single regex pattern with alternation (|) to match ANY of: help, support, faq, or frequently.*asked
The pattern 'help|support|faq|frequently.*asked' is flexible and will match various Help Center/FAQ URLs
Getter (active_tab_info) correctly extracts the active tab URL
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly checks URL against the pattern - only one pattern in list, so loop runs once
Coverage is complete - checking URL is sufficient to verify user found a help/FAQ page
Pattern is not overly restrictive - matches any of the common help center URL patterns
